name: Blip
tagline: A very small phone. Calls, texts, email.
summary: A very small phone with a 3-inch screen. It does calls, texts and email, plus an alarm clock and a torch. £149.
concept: Blip is a tiny phone that does calls, texts and email, plus an alarm clock and a torch. It has a 3-inch touchscreen, a battery that lasts days and a USB-C port.
why_it_exists: A lot of the time a phone is only needed to ring, to text and to check email. Blip does those and leaves the rest out.
target_customer: People who want a second phone, a weekend phone, or a first phone, and who are happy with fewer things on it.

physical.form: A slim, rounded slab with a 3-inch touchscreen, a matte back and a single power key on the right edge. USB-C on the bottom. A small loop in the frame for a lanyard.

features: You can make calls on Blip.
You can send texts on Blip.
You can send and read emails on Blip.
Blip works as an alarm clock.
Blip does not have a camera, apps or a web browser.
arrives: Blip comes in a small brown card box with a pull-out tray, held shut by a paper band. The phone is wrapped in recycled paper and there is no plastic film. Charge it before you set it up; the charger is sold separately.
specs: Aluminium frame, matte recycled-polymer back, toughened glass front
Sky (off-white body with sky blue, orange and pink accents)
Calls (4G, with Wi-Fi calling), texts and email, plus an alarm clock and a torch. No app store, no browser, no camera.
Up to 5 days of normal use. About 10 days on standby (1,800 mAh, not user-removable)
USB-C, about 1 hour from flat. The Blip Charger is sold separately.
One nano-SIM, Wi-Fi 5, Bluetooth 5.3, USB-C. No headphone socket. Splash resistant (not independently tested).
how_it_works: Charge it, put in a nano-SIM and follow the setup. Sign in to your email. You make calls and send texts with your normal number.
in_the_box: No plug. The Blip Charger is sold separately.

accessories.name: Blip Case
accessories.tagline: A soft case that fits Blip only.
accessories.description: A soft case made for Blip. It has a raised lip around the screen to keep the glass off the table. It fits Blip only, not any other phone.
specs: 104 x 60 x 14 mm outside, for a phone that is 96 x 52 x 9 mm
Blip only. It will not fit other phones, and Blip will not fit other cases.
Has an opening for the lanyard loop on Blip's frame
Wipe with a damp cloth. Take Blip out to clean underneath.

accessories.name: Blip Charger
accessories.tagline: A plug and cable for Blip.
accessories.description: A plug and a braided USB-C cable that charge Blip. They also charge the Boombox Mini. They will charge other USB-C devices too, but we have only matched them to Blip and the Boombox Mini.
specs: Plastic plug, braided nylon cable, metal USB-C ends
White plug, sky blue cable with an orange end
1 m, fixed to the plug, USB-C
20 W maximum. UK 3-pin plug, 100 to 240 V.
Wipe dry. Keep away from water.

accessories.name: Blip Lanyard
accessories.tagline: A lanyard that threads through Blip.
accessories.description: A woven lanyard, 120 cm long, that threads through the loop on Blip's frame so you can wear it around your neck. It is made for Blip. It is not made for other phones or for the Boombox Mini.
specs: Blip only, through the loop in its frame
Threads through the loop. No clips.
Wipe, or hand wash and air dry

compatibility.note: It charges Blip and Boombox Mini.
It threads through the loop in Blip's frame.
It pairs over Bluetooth. They share a charger.
It is too small to need a case, and it fits the Daypack's front pouch. It does not fit the Daypack's side bottle holder.

packaging: A kraft card box with a pull-out tray and a paper band. No plastic film. The phone is wrapped in recycled paper and the cable is held with a paper loop.

warranty.summary: It has a 24-month warranty against faults in how it was made. Battery fade to 80% is wear, and drops and liquid damage are not covered. See Warranty.

care: Clean the screen with a soft, slightly damp cloth. Dry it straight away.
Keep it away from heat above 35 °C. A parked car in summer counts.
Use a damage-free USB-C cable and charger.
Do not open the phone yourself. Repairs by anyone other than The Fix Club are outside the warranty.
safety: It resists splashes. Do not charge it wet or put it under water.
Do not use a damaged charger or cable.
If the battery swells or gets hot, stop using it, unplug it and contact us.

delivery.note: Soon or Sooner. Soon is free over £50.

returnable.note: You can return it within 30 days. You may switch it on and try it, but it must be undamaged, complete, in its box and reset with any account removed. See Returns.

page.headline: A very small phone
page.intro: A very small phone. Calls, texts, email.

sections.title: What it does
sections.body: You can make calls, send texts and send and read emails on Blip. It works as an alarm clock and it has a torch. It does not have a camera, apps or a web browser.

sections.title: Size and battery
sections.body: It is 96 mm tall and weighs 76 g. The battery lasts days, and it charges over USB-C.

sections.title: Looking after it
sections.body: The Fix Club replaces the screen for £49 and the battery for £29. The warranty is 24 months.

faq.a: You can make calls, send texts and send and read emails. It is also an alarm clock and a torch.

faq.q: Can I add other things to it?
faq.a: No. It has no camera, apps or web browser, and you cannot add them.
Standard email accounts. Sign in on the phone with your address and password.

faq.q: How long does the battery last?
faq.a: Up to 5 days of normal use. It charges over USB-C.
Screen £49, battery £29. A fault in warranty is free.

steps: Plug it in and leave it for 15 minutes.
Hold the power key for 10 seconds.
Try a different cable and socket.
troubleshooting.if_unresolved: Open a support case. In warranty, The Fix Club will look at it.

troubleshooting.problem: It charges slowly or not at all.
steps: Push the cable in fully and clear any lint from the port with a wooden toothpick.
troubleshooting.if_unresolved: Open a support case. A loose port may need The Fix Club.

troubleshooting.problem: I cannot make calls or send texts.
steps: Check the SIM is in the right way round.
Check you have signal. Move to a window or outside.
troubleshooting.if_unresolved: Ask your mobile network if the SIM is active, then open a support case.
